ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p51/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p51/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p51/r5.claim: Warning benefits the one who follows the reminder—identified as the Qurʾān, or by Qatāda as admonition—and fears the Merciful in private, fearing loss of His blessings; such a person receives forgiveness and Paradise.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p51/r5.anchor: إنما تنذر: أي إنذارا ينفع من اتبع الذكر، وهو القرآن

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p376/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p376/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p376/r1.claim: Reminders benefit those who heed counsel, open their hearts, and reason beyond the senses; valuable faith is professed through sight, hearing, mind, and heart before direct visual proof, while the Prophet leaves sight-demanders to God.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p376/r1.anchor: Only that faith is of value to God which is professed by using the faculties of sight, hearing, mind as well as the heart

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p376/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p376/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p376/r2.claim: Fear of God follows from His graciousness: He must reward the pious and punish wrongdoers, so the appointed Day displays mercy and justice perfectly.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p376/r2.anchor: For the manifestation of His graciousness, He has appointed a day for reward and punishment

ASAD-NOTES:36:11#n9/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:36:11#n9/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:36:11#n9/r1.claim: The literal wording is ‘who is following the reminder.’

ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r14.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r14.speaker: author
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r14.claim: Although most are unresponsive, the Prophet must warn everyone, since warning benefits and protects those who respond.
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r14.anchor: sen yine umûmunu da inzar edeceksin, çünkü inzarının o kimselere fâidesi

ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r15.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r15.speaker: author
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r15.claim: Following the Reminder means seriously reflecting on and reciting the Qur'an and heeding its admonition.
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r15.anchor: zikri tâkip etmekte kitabı, Kur’ân’ı cidden düşünerek vird etmekte, nasihat dinlemekte

ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r16.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r16.speaker: author
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r16.claim: Fearing the Merciful unseen means revering His majesty while not yet in His presence, fearing punishment without presuming on His mercy, and obeying His commands; al-Hijr 15:49 holds mercy and painful punishment together.
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r16.anchor: âhirette olacağı gibi henüz huzûruna varmış olmayıp gıyâbında bulunduğu hâlde O’nun celâl ü azametini sayarak ikābından korkar, Rahmân’dır diye rahmetine mağrur olmaz.

ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r17.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r17.speaker: author
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r17.claim: Alternatively, “unseen” means inwardly, in the hidden heart that no one but God can know, rather than merely outwardly.
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r17.anchor: zâhiri değil, Allah’tan başka kimsenin vâkıf olamayacağı kalbinin iç yüzünden haşyet duyar.

ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r18.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r18.speaker: author
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r18.claim: People of any community who respond are promised forgiveness and a noble reward; the accusative nunation magnifies a forgiveness covering every sin and an honorable reward without favor or deficiency.
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r18.anchor: “Mağfiret” ve “ecr”deki tenvinler tefhıym içindir. Yani hiçbir günah bırakmayıp örten geniş, ehemmiyetli bir mağfiret

ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r19.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r19.speaker: author
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r19.claim: The wisdom of the mission includes generous glad tidings as well as warning.
ELMALILI:36:1-12#3/r19.anchor: Demek ki risalet yalnız inzar için değil, hem de böyle büyük müjde ile tebşir hikmeti içindir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r1.speaker: İbn Atıyye
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r1.claim: The word only limits who benefits from the warning, not who falls within its scope.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r1.anchor: Buradaki “ancak” kaydı, belirtilenler dışındakilerin uyarı kapsamında olmadıkları anlamında değil, uyarının sadece onlara yarar sağlayacağını belirtmek içindir (İbn Atıyye, IV, 448).

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r2.speaker: Müfessirler
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r2.claim: Most commentators understand dhikr here to mean the Qur’an.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r2.anchor: Müfessirler arasında, bu âyette geçen “zikir” kelimesiyle Kur’an-ı Kerîm’in kastedildiği kanaati hâkimdir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r3.speaker: Râzî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r3.claim: Others take dhikr to mean Qur’anic signs or clear proofs that complete human nature.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:36:11/r3.anchor: Bunu Kur’an’daki âyetler veya insanın fıtratını tamamlayan açık kanıtlar şeklinde yorumlayanlar da olmuştur (Râzî, XXVI, 47).

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r4.claim: Verses 1–12 establish Muhammad’s prophethood: the wise Qur’an is the strongest evidence that he is God’s messenger calling people to the straight path.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r4.anchor: the Qur’ān replete with wisdom is the greatest evidence to the fact that he is a messenger of God

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r5.claim: The Qur’an is God’s favor to people who lacked divine guidance and wandered astray; arrogance makes them deny it, while inherited traditions and future desires block reflection.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r5.anchor: The Qur’ān is a great favour from the Almighty and powerful God to people who till then were deprived of any divine guidance

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r6.claim: The Prophet should not worry over those who will not listen; he should promise a great reward to those who fear God and are ready to receive counsel.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r6.anchor: He should give glad tidings of a great reward to those who fear God and are prepared to listen

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r7.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r7.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r7.claim: The Prophet should leave nonlisteners to God, who has recorded their deeds and can deal with them.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p370/r7.anchor: He should leave the matter of those who do not listen to God. He has recorded all their deeds

BURSEVI:v7p292/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p292/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p292/r3.claim: Only warning that benefits those who follow the Qurʾan through reflection or admonition, without persisting in Satan's path, reaches its target.
BURSEVI:v7p292/r3.anchor: القرآن بالتأمل فيه أو الوعظ والتذكير ولم يصر على اتباع خطوات الشيطان

BURSEVI:v7p292/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p292/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p292/r4.claim: Fearing the Merciful unseen means fearing His punishment before it arrives or while unseen by people, without being deceived by mercy because He is also avenging and overpowering.
BURSEVI:v7p292/r4.anchor: خاف عقابه تعالى والحال أنه غائب عن العقاب

BURSEVI:v7p292/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p292/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p292/r5.claim: The Merciful is named alongside fear because one whose blessings come largely through mercy fears most that its continuous favors may be cut off.
BURSEVI:v7p292/r5.anchor: ومن كان نعمته بسبب رحمته أكثر فالخوف منه أتم مخافة أن يقطع عنه النعم المتواترة

BURSEVI:v7p292/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p292/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p292/r6.claim: Al-Taʾwīlāt al-Najmiyya interprets unseen fear as mystically witnessing the dire end of disbelief and disobedience and verifying the sweetness of faith and rank of gnosis.
BURSEVI:v7p292/r6.anchor: بنور غيبتي يشاهد وخامة عاقبة الكفر والعصيان ويتحقق عنده بشواهد الحق

BURSEVI:v7p292/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p292/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p292/r7.claim: The singular pronoun in the promise refers to the person who both follows and fears; forgiveness is great, and the incomparable gracious reward is Paradise and its gifts.
BURSEVI:v7p292/r7.anchor: من اتبع وخشي وحد الضمير مراعاة اللفظ

BURSEVI:v7p292/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p292/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p292/r8.claim: Bursevi pairs the outcomes with their causes: reflection and being moved by admonition lead to faith and forgiveness, while fear leads to good deeds and gracious reward.
BURSEVI:v7p292/r8.anchor: رتب التبشير بمثنى على مثنى فالتأمل في القرآن والتأثر من الوعظ يؤدي إلى الإيمان المؤدي إلى المغفرة

BURSEVI:v7p293/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p293/r1.claim: The plural We expresses God's majesty and many attributes; a view that angels share in reviving the dead is challenged by the emphatic We alone.
BURSEVI:v7p293/r1.anchor: من مقام كمال قدرتنا والجمع للتعظيم ولكثرة الصفات

BURSEVI:v7p293/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293/r2.speaker: البحر
BURSEVI:v7p293/r2.claim: Al-Baḥr says the repeated pronoun adds emphasis: God raises people after death and recompenses them by their deeds, manifesting full honor and retribution.
BURSEVI:v7p293/r2.anchor: قال في "البحر" : كرر الضمير لتكرير التأكيد

BURSEVI:v7p293/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p293/r3.claim: Reviving means making something living with sensation and motion; the Prophet also called affluent people and unjust rulers dead.
BURSEVI:v7p293/r3.anchor: والإحياء جعل الشيء حيا ذا حس وحركة والميت من أخرج روحه وقد أطلق النبي عليه السلام لفظ الموتى

BURSEVI:v7p293/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293/r4.speaker: النبي
BURSEVI:v7p293/r4.claim: A Prophetic report says four things kill the heart: repeated sin, excessive company and talk with women, arguing with a fool, and keeping company with the dead, meaning an affluent person or unjust ruler.
BURSEVI:v7p293/r4.anchor: أربع يمتن القلب الذنب على الذنب وكثرة مصاحبة النساء وحديثهن وملاحاة الأحمق

BURSEVI:v7p293/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p293/r5.claim: Al-Taʾwīlāt al-Najmiyya reads reviving as bringing hardened, dead hearts to life with a shower of divine turning and closeness.
BURSEVI:v7p293/r5.anchor: نحيى قلوبا ماتت بالقسوة بما نمطر عليها من صوب الإقبال والزلفة

BURSEVI:v7p293/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p293/r6.claim: We write means either preserve and establish in the Preserved Tablet or have the noble recording angels write; the act is attributed to God to warn and because He commands it.
BURSEVI:v7p293/r6.anchor: نحفظ ونثبت في اللوح المحفوظ يدل عليه آخر الآية

BURSEVI:v7p293/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p293/r7.claim: What people send ahead means the good and evil deeds they have already done.

BURSEVI:v7p293/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p293/r8.claim: Writing is mentioned after revival although it precedes it because writing serves resurrection and would have no purpose without return to life.
BURSEVI:v7p293/r8.anchor: وإنما أخر الكتابة مع أنها مقدمة على الإحياء لأنها ليست مقصودة لذاتها

BURSEVI:v7p293/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p293/r9.claim: Their traces include good works left behind: knowledge taught, books authored, endowed works, and building mosques, hospices, bridges, and other charitable works.
BURSEVI:v7p293/r9.anchor: آثارهم التي أبقوها من الحسنات كعلم علموه أو كتاب ألفوه

BURSEVI:v7p293/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293/r10.speaker: سعدي
BURSEVI:v7p293/r10.claim: Saʿdī's couplet supports the point that a person does not die while a good legacy remains after him.
BURSEVI:v7p293/r10.anchor: قال الشيخ سعدي : نمرد آنكه ماند س از وى بجاى

QASHANI:36:11/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:36:11/r1.speaker: author
QASHANI:36:11/r1.claim: Warning benefits only one who follows the Reminder, because pure, luminous preparedness lets the person respond and accept guidance through innate monotheism and original knowledge.
QASHANI:36:11/r1.anchor: لنورية استعداده وصفائه فيتأثر به ويقبل الهداية بما في استعداده من التوحيد الفطري

QASHANI:36:11/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:36:11/r2.speaker: author
QASHANI:36:11/r2.claim: Such a person remembers and fears the Merciful by conceiving His majesty while veiled from disclosure, then follows the path to become present to what had been absent and see by its light.
QASHANI:36:11/r2.anchor: بتصور عظمته مع غيبته من التجلي فيتبعه بالسلوك ليحضر ما هو غائب عنه

QASHANI:36:11/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:36:11/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:36:11/r3.claim: Forgiveness is a vast veiling of sins that veil God's acts, attributes, and Essence.
QASHANI:36:11/r3.anchor: عظيمة من ستر ذنوب حجب أفعاله وصفاته وذاته

QASHANI:36:11/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:36:11/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:36:11/r4.claim: The noble reward consists of gardens of the Real's acts, attributes, and Essence.
QASHANI:36:11/r4.anchor: من جنات أفعال الحق وصفاته وذاته

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r1.claim: After explaining that warning has seemed ineffective for the opponents, the verse identifies those whom warning actually benefits.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r1.anchor: ولما بين كون الإنذار عندهم كعدمه عقب ببيان من يتأثر منه فقال سبحانه

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r2.speaker: قتادة
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r2.claim: The reminder is the Qurʾān, and following it means reflecting on it and acting upon it.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r2.anchor: أي القرآن كما روى عن قتادة بالتأمل فيه والعمل به

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r3.claim: Alternatively, the reminder means admonition, and the past form of ‘followed’ denotes the certainty of future following.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r3.anchor: وقيل : الوعظ وأتبع بمعنى يتبع والتعبير بالماضي لتحقق الوقوع

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r4.claim: Alternatively, those warned are believers who already followed the reminder; warning alerts them to future lapses, avoiding a redundant warning.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r4.anchor: أو المعنى إنما ينفع إنذارك المؤمنين الذين أتبعوا ويكون المراد بمن أتبع المؤمنين

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r5.claim: Alternatively, the phrase denotes those whom God knows will follow, the smaller group against whom the decree has not become binding.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r5.anchor: وقيل : المراد من أتبع في علم الله تعالى وهم الأقلون الذين لم يحق القول عليهم

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r6.claim: Fearing the Merciful means fearing His punishment rather than presuming upon His mercy; He is merciful yet inflicts painful punishment.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r6.anchor: أي عقابه ولم يغتر برحمته عزوجل فإنه سبحانه مع عظم رحمته أليم العذاب

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r7.claim: Calling God al-Raḥmān alongside fear signals the coexistence of great mercy with painful punishment.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r7.anchor: ومما قرر يعلم سر ذكر الرحمن مع الخشية دون القهار ونحوه

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r8.claim: Al-ghayb may describe the absent punishment: the person fears it before it arrives and its terrors are witnessed.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r8.anchor: أي خشي عقاب الرحمن حال كون العقاب ملتبسا بالغيب أي غائبا عنه وحاصله خشي العقاب قبل حلوله

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r9.claim: Alternatively, al-ghayb is a circumstantial phrase for the person fearing punishment while it remains unseen.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r9.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون حالا من فاعل ( خشي ) أي خشى عقاب الرحمن غائبا عن العقاب غير مشاهد له

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r10.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r10.claim: Some take it to mean fearing God privately, without displaying fear to people and risking ostentation.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r10.anchor: أو خشي غائبا عن أعين الناس غير مظهر الخشية لهم لأنها علانية فلما تسلم عن الرياء

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r11.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r11.claim: Another reported explanation construes al-ghayb as the heart, with the preposition attached to ‘feared.’
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r11.anchor: وبعضهم فسر الغيب بالقلب وجعل الجار متعلقا بخشي أي خشي في قلبه

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r12.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r12.claim: Forgiveness may cover past sins or possible future lapses.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r12.anchor: فبشره بمغفرة ( عظيمة لما سلف وقيل : لما يفرط منه ( وأجر كريم

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r13.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r13.speaker: قتادة
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r13.claim: Qatāda explains the noble reward as Paradise, with its incomparable delights and, above all, the vision of God.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r13.anchor: وعن قتادة تفسير الأجر الكريم بالجنة والمراد نعيمها الشامل لما لا عين رأت

ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r14.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r14.speaker: أبو حيان
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r14.claim: The conjunction orders the good news after following the reminder and fearing God; Abū Ḥayyān says the warning has benefited this person.
ALUSI-FULL:v22p217#2/r14.anchor: والفاء لترتيب البشارة أو الأمر بها على ما قبلها من إتباع الذكر والخشية وفي البحر لما أجدت فيه النذارة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p9#2/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p9#2/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p9#2/r4.claim: The warning benefits whoever follows the Qur'an and acts on it, fears the Merciful unseen, and receives glad tidings of forgiveness and Paradise.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p9#2/r4.anchor: يعني: إنما ينفع إنذارك من اتبع الذكر، يعني القرآن، فعمل بما فيه،

BAYDAWI-FULL:36:10-11/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:36:10-11/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:36:10-11/r2.claim: Only warning that achieves the intended benefit reaches the one who follows the Qur’an through reflection and practice.
BAYDAWI-FULL:36:10-11/r2.anchor: إنذارا يترتب عليه البغية المرومة. { من اتبع الذكر } أي القرآن بالتأمل فيه والعمل به

BAYDAWI-FULL:36:10-11/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:36:10-11/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:36:10-11/r3.claim: He fears the Merciful unseen by fearing punishment before it arrives and its terrors are seen, or by fearing inwardly without being deceived by mercy, since God is also avenging and overpowering.
BAYDAWI-FULL:36:10-11/r3.anchor: وخاف عقابه قبل حلوله ومعاينة أهواله، أو في سريرته ولا يغتر برحمته فإنه كما هو رحمن، منتقم قهار

SULAMI:v2p171#4/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p171#4/r1.speaker: الحسين
SULAMI:v2p171#4/r1.claim: The highest station of those who remember God is to forget their own remembrance while witnessing the Remembered, and to guard their time from returning to awareness of remembrance.
SULAMI:v2p171#4/r1.anchor: قال الحسين : اشرف منازل الذاكرين من نسي ذكره في مشاهدة مذكوره

BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r16.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r16.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r16.claim: Only a warning that the hearer benefits from and that leads to salvation is meant; in effect, only one who believes benefits from the Prophet's warning.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r16.anchor: أي إنذارا ينتفع به المنذر فيتأثر عنه النجاة , فالمعنى : إنما يؤمن بإنذارك

BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r17.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r17.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r17.claim: Following the Reminder means striving to follow everything that recalls God, including the Quran and other reminders that ennoble their recipient.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r17.anchor: أي أجهد نفسه في اتباع كل ما يذكر بالله من القرآن وغيره ويذكر به صاحبه ويشرف

BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r18.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r18.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r18.claim: They fear the All-Merciful intensely; the shift from the expression of majesty to mercy shows that reminders of God's kindness suffice to teach the fearful.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r18.anchor: ودل لفت الكلام عن مظهر العظمة إلى الوصف بالرحمانية على أن أهل الخشية يكفيهم في الاتعاظ التذكير بالإحسان

BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r19.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r19.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r19.claim: Fearing God unseen means believing in unseen powers, especially resurrection, without demanding a sign that removes the veil and turns faith into direct witnessing; fear also includes the possibility of punishment or lost favor.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r19.anchor: أي بسبب ما يخبر به من مقدوراته الغائبة لا سيما البعث

BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r20.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r20.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r20.claim: The unseen fear is also sincere fear when no human observer is present to impress.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r20.anchor: ويخشاه أيضا خشية خالصة في حال غيبته عمن يرائيه من الناس

BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r21.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r21.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r21.claim: These are the guided God-fearing people; others cannot be set right, so the Prophet should grieve no more than his duty to warn, while God knows who is receptive and who is hardened.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r21.anchor: فلا تذهب نفسك عليهم حسرات , فإنه ليس عليك إلا الإنذار , إن الله عليم بما يصنعون

BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r22.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r22.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r22.claim: The singular “give him good news” follows the singular form “whoever” and signals how few such people are in this comprehensive, heart-like surah.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r22.anchor: فقال مفردا الضمير على النسق الماضي في مراعاة لفظ ( من ) دلالة على قلة هذا الصنف

BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r23.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r23.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r23.claim: Forgiveness covers even grave and repeatedly committed sins; repeated return to sin and repentance does not prevent a person from having true fear of God.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r23.anchor: أي لذنوبه وإن عظمت وإن تكررت مواقعته لها وتوبته منها , فإن ذلك لا يمنع الاتصاف بالخشية .

BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r24.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r24.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r24.claim: The generous reward is an immense, pleasant, continuous abode with no discomfort.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p246/r24.anchor: أي دار عظيم هنيء لذيذ متواصل , لا كدر فيه بوجه .

TUSTARI:36:11/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:36:11/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:36:11/r1.claim: Worshipping God in secret begets certainty; worshipping with a truthful tongue makes the heart reach toward the Throne; worshipping with fairness places heaven and earth in one's balance.
TUSTARI:36:11/r1.anchor: من عبدالله في سره أورثه اليقين، ومن عبدالله بصدق اللسان لم يستقر قلبه دون العرش

TUSTARI:36:11/r2.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:36:11/r2.speaker: author
TUSTARI:36:11/r2.claim: Fairness with God means every limb moves only for Him; seeking tomorrow's provision negates fairness because the heart cannot carry two concerns.
TUSTARI:36:11/r2.anchor: الإنصاف أن لا تتحرك جميع أعضائك إلا لله، ومتى طالبته برزق الغد فقد ذهب إنصافك، لأن القلب لا يحمل همين

TUSTARI:36:11/r3.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:36:11/r3.speaker: author
TUSTARI:36:11/r3.claim: Fairness toward people means taking the generous course; one who demands fairness for himself is not fair.
TUSTARI:36:11/r3.anchor: والإنصاف بينك وبين الخلق أن تأخذ بالفضل، فإذا طلبت الإنصاف فلست بمنصف

TUSTARI:36:11/r4.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:36:11/r4.speaker: author
TUSTARI:36:11/r4.claim: Sahl recounts Jesus reproaching John after he struck a woman: although John's body walked beside him, his heart was fixed at the Throne.
TUSTARI:36:11/r4.anchor: وحكي عن يحيى وعيسى عليهما السلام أنهما خرجا يمشيان، فصدم يحيى امرأة

TUSTARI:36:11/r5.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:36:11/r5.speaker: يحيى
TUSTARI:36:11/r5.claim: John says that if his heart rested for even an instant in Gabriel, he would suspect that he had not truly known God.
TUSTARI:36:11/r5.anchor: قال: معلق بالعرش، ولو أن قلبي اطمأن إلى جبريل صلوات الله عليه طرفة عين

DURR-FULL:v7p45/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p45/r5.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v7p45/r5.claim: Qatada says following the reminder means following the Qur’an.
DURR-FULL:v7p45/r5.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله {إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر} قال: اتباع الذكر اتباع القرآن

DURR-FULL:v7p45/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p45/r6.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v7p45/r6.claim: Qatada says fearing the Merciful unseen means fearing God’s punishment and fire.
DURR-FULL:v7p45/r6.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله {إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر} قال: اتباع الذكر اتباع القرآن {وخشي الرحمن بالغيب} قال: خشي عذاب الله وناره

DURR-FULL:v7p45/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p45/r7.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v7p45/r7.claim: Qatada identifies the promised forgiveness and noble reward as Paradise.
DURR-FULL:v7p45/r7.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله {إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر} قال: اتباع الذكر اتباع القرآن {وخشي الرحمن بالغيب} قال: خشي عذاب الله وناره

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r1.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r1.claim: Qatada says following the Reminder means following the Qur’an.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله : انما تنذر من اتبع الذكر قال : اتباع الذكر اتباع القران

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r2.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r2.claim: Qatada interprets fearing the All-Merciful unseen as fearing God’s punishment and Fire.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r2.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله : انما تنذر من اتبع الذكر قال : اتباع الذكر اتباع القران وخشي الرحمن بالغيب قال : خشي عذاب الله وناره

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r3.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r3.claim: Qatada takes the promised forgiveness and noble reward to mean Paradise.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3189#3/r3.anchor: قتادة في قوله : انما تنذر من اتبع الذكر قال : اتباع الذكر اتباع القران وخشي الرحمن بالغيب قال : خشي عذاب الله وناره فبشره بمغفرة واجر كريم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r5.claim: Innamā here specifies those who benefit from warning rather than strictly excluding anyone else.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r5.anchor: وقوله إنما تنذر ليس على جهة الحصر ب إنما بل على تجهة تخصيص

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r6.claim: Following the Reminder means acting according to God’s Book and following it; Qatāda identifies the Reminder as the Qur’an.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r6.anchor: و «اتباع الذكر» هو العمل بما في كتاب الله تعالى

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r7.claim: Bi-l-ghayb means fearing God in private, when a person is out of the sight of other people.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r7.anchor: وقوله تعالى: بالغيب أي بالخلوات عند مغيب الإنسان

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r8.claim: The singular pronoun in ‘give him good news’ follows the grammatical singular form of man.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r9.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r9.claim: A noble reward is what a worker receives with praise and honor; for believers it is Paradise.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p447#3/r9.anchor: و «الأجر الكريم» هو كل ما يأخذه الأجير

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p8#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p8#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p8#2/r1.claim: The warning benefits only those who follow the Qur'an and act upon it.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p8#2/r1.anchor: ثم أخبر عمن ينفعه الإنذار بقوله ﴿ إنما تنذر ﴾ أي إنما ينفع إنذارك

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p8#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p8#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p8#2/r2.claim: The explanation of fearing the Merciful unseen was given at al-Anbiya 21:49.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p8#2/r2.anchor: ﴿ وخشي الرحمن بالغيب ﴾ وقد شرحناه في الأنبياء 49

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r2.claim: Only believers who follow the Qur'an benefit from the warning; fearing the Merciful unseen means knowing that God sees and knows what they do even when no one else does.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r2.anchor: {إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر} أي: إنما ينتفع بإنذارك المؤمنون الذين يتبعون الذكر، وهو القرآن العظيم، {وخشي الرحمن}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r3.claim: The warning brings such people forgiveness of their sins and a great, abundant, beautiful reward, like the reward promised to those who fear God unseen.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r3.anchor: {فبشره بمغفرة} أي: لذنوبه، {وأجر كريم} أي: كبير واسع حسن جميل

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r4.claim: God will raise the dead on Resurrection Day; the verse also hints that He can revive the dead hearts of some disbelievers by guiding them from error to truth.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p565/r4.anchor: وفيه إشارة إلى أن الله تعالى يحيي قلب من يشاء من الكفار الذين قد ماتت قلوبهم بالضلالة

JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r8.claim: The Prophet's warning benefits those who follow and accept the Qur'an; fearing the Merciful unseen means either in private, unlike hypocrites, or fearing unseen matters of the afterlife.
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r8.anchor: إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر أي: القرآن، يعني: أنك وإن جئت منذرا للجميع، فإنما ينتفع بإنذارك من يتبع القرآن ويقبله

JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r9.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r9.claim: One explanation of fearing God unseen is that a person's private conduct differs from the hypocrites' conduct.
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r9.anchor: قيل: حال غيبتهم عن الناس خلاف المنافقين

JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r10.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r10.claim: Another explanation says the believer fears unseen matters of the afterlife.
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r10.anchor: وقيل: خبر ما غاب عنه من أمر الآخرة

JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r11.claim: The promised forgiveness and noble reward are a reward free of impurities.
JISHUMI:v8p5870#2/r11.anchor: فبشره يعني: هؤلاء بمغفرة من الله وأجر كريم أي: ثواب خالص من الشوائب

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r8.speaker: السدي
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r8.claim: He takes fearing the Merciful unseen to mean concealing the evil of one's deeds from other people.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r8.anchor: ما يغيب به عن الناس من شر عمله , قاله السدي

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r9.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r9.claim: He takes it to mean fearing God's unseen punishment and Fire.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r9.anchor: ما غاب من عذاب الله وناره , قاله قتادة

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r10.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r10.claim: The promised forgiveness is for the believer's sin.

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r11.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r11.claim: The generous reward is for the believer's obedience.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r11.anchor: لذنبه . { وأجر كريم } لطاعته ، وفيه وجهان

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r12.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r12.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r12.claim: One interpretation of a generous reward is that it is abundant.

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r13.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r13.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p8/r13.claim: Another interpretation is a reward accompanied by honor.

NAHHAS:v3p385/r10.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v3p385/r10.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v3p385/r10.claim: Only the person who follows the Reminder benefits from the warning.

NAHHAS:v3p385/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v3p385/r11.speaker: أبو إسحاق
NAHHAS:v3p385/r11.claim: Abu Ishaq explains fearing the Merciful in the unseen as fearing God when no one sees the person except God.
NAHHAS:v3p385/r11.anchor: قال أبو إسحاق ومعنى ( وخشي الرحمن بالغيب ) خاف الله جل وعز من حيث لا يراه أحد إلا الله عز وجل

NAHHAS:v3p385/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v3p385/r12.speaker: الضحاك عن ابن عباس
NAHHAS:v3p385/r12.claim: Dahhak, reporting Ibn Abbas, glosses كريم as good or beautiful.
NAHHAS:v3p385/r12.anchor: قال الضحاك عن ابن عباس في معنى كريم أي حسن

NAHHAS:v3p385/r13.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v3p385/r13.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v3p385/r13.claim: Another interpretation takes the noble reward to mean Paradise; the author leaves the matter to God.
NAHHAS:v3p385/r13.anchor: وقيل يراد به الجنة والله جل وعز أعلم

MUQATIL:36:11-12/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:36:11-12/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:36:11-12/r1.claim: The passage is connected with Abu Jahl and the verses in al-ʿAlaq about one who forbids a servant from praying.

MUQATIL:36:11-12/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:36:11-12/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:36:11-12/r2.claim: The warning benefits one who follows the Qur’an, fears the Merciful’s punishment despite not seeing Him, and receives glad tidings of forgiveness and a fine reward in Paradise.
MUQATIL:36:11-12/r2.anchor: القرآن { وخشي الرحمن } وخشى عذاب الرحمن { بالغيب } ولم يره { فبشره بمغفرة } لذنوبهم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r1.claim: Only those who follow the Reminder, meaning the Quran, benefit from the Prophet’s warning.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r1.anchor: أى إنما ينتفع بإنذاك من ابتع القرآن

NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r2.claim: They fear the Merciful’s punishment without seeing Him.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r3.claim: Forgiveness means pardon for sins, and the noble reward is Paradise.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p4#4/r3.anchor: ﴿ فبشره بمغفرة ﴾ وهي العفو عن ذنوبه ﴿ وأجر كريم ﴾ أى الجنة

QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r11.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r11.claim: The one who follows the reminder is the one who follows the Quran and acts upon it.
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r11.anchor: { إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر } يعني القرآن وعمل به.

QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r12.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r12.claim: Qatada says fearing the Merciful in the unseen means fearing His punishment and fire, which are unseen.
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r12.anchor: { وخشي الرحمن بالغيب } أي ما غاب من عذابه وناره قاله قتادة.

QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r13.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r13.claim: Another interpretation is fearing God when hidden from people's sight and alone.
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r13.anchor: وقيل: أي يخشاه في مغيبه عن أبصار الناس وانفراده بنفسه.

QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r14.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r14.claim: God's forgiveness is forgiveness of the person's sin, and the generous reward is Paradise.
QURTUBI-FULL:36:9-11/r14.anchor: { فبشره بمغفرة } أي لذنبه { وأجر كريم } أي الجنة.

RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r1.claim: One reconciliation is that the command to warn is general regardless of its effect, while effective warning reaches only those who follow the Reminder and fear God.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r1.anchor: قوله : { لتنذر } أي كيفما كان سواء كان مفيدا أو لم يكن وقوله : { إنما تنذر } أي الإنذار المفيد

RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r2.claim: A second reconciliation is to warn everyone because the Prophet cannot know whom he will guide, while the intended beneficiaries are those who respond; even the stubborn are not the only audience.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r2.anchor: فأنذر على سبيل العموم وإنما تنذر بذلك الإنذار العام من يتبع الذكر

RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r3.claim: A third reconciliation makes the warning general at first; after the Prophet has fully delivered it and some mock, turn away, or act arrogantly, only followers remain receptive to warning.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r3.anchor: قوله : { لتنذر } أي أولا فإذا أنذرت وبالغت وبلغت واستهزأ البعض وتولى واستكبر وولى

RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r4.claim: A closely related view distinguishes levels: warn everyone about foundational beliefs, but warn followers of the Reminder about practical duties such as prayer and almsgiving.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42/r4.anchor: إنك تنذر الكل بالأصول ، وإنما تنذر بالفروع من ترك الصلاة والزكاة من اتبع الذكر

RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r1.claim: Following the Reminder may mean following the Quran itself, the Quran's signs, or demonstrative proof that completes innate nature; on each reading the warned are learned people who fear God.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r1.anchor: من اتبع القرآن الثاني : من اتبع ما في القرآن من الآيات

RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r2.claim: Following the Reminder means faith and fearing the Merciful means righteous action; forgiveness corresponds to faith and the noble reward to deeds.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r2.anchor: قوله : { اتبع الذكر } أي آمن ، وقوله : { وخشى الرحمان } أي عمل صالحا

RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r3.claim: The definite article in Reminder supports identifying it as the Quran already mentioned as the Wise Quran.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r3.anchor: وتفسير الذكر بالقرآن يتأيد بتعريف الذكر بالألف واللام ، وقد تقدم ذكر القرآن في قوله تعالى : { والقرءان الحكيم }

RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r4.claim: Although mercy tends to produce hope and reliance, the wise should still fear the Merciful, whose repeated gifts make the prospect of their withdrawal weighty.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r4.anchor: وهي أن الرحمة تورث الاتكال والرجاء فقال مع أنه رحمن ورحيم

RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r5.claim: Allah and al-Rahman are described as two names particular to God: Allah conveys awe and al-Rahman affection, so one should fear Him without despair and hope in Him without feeling safe.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r5.anchor: فالله اسم ينبىء عن الهيبة والرحمن ينبىء عن العاطفية

RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r6.claim: Fear in the unseen can mean fear based on evidence before matters become visible, when fear would no longer serve a purpose.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r6.anchor: يعني بالدليل وإن لم ينته إلى درجة المرئي المشاهد فإن عند الانتهاء إلى تلك الدرجة لا يبقى للخشية فائدة

RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r7.claim: The common interpretation of fearing God in the unseen is fear concerning the unseen realities of the Resurrection; another view includes divine unity.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r7.anchor: والمشهور أن المراد بالغيب ما غاب عنا وهو أحوال القيامة ، وقيل إن الوحدانية تدخل فيه

RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r8.claim: The promise of good news signals the second part of the Messenger's task after warning; those who benefit from warning should also receive glad tidings.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r8.anchor: فيه إشارة إلى الأمر الثاني من أمري الرسالة فإن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بشير ونذير

RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r9.claim: The indefinite forgiveness signifies an immense forgiveness that covers every side, leaving no trace of the lower self and revealing the lights of the purified spirit.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r9.anchor: على التنكير أي بمغفرة واسعة تستر من جميع الجوانب حتى لا يرى عليه أثر من آثار النفس

RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r10.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r10.claim: A noble reward is a reward characterized by generosity; Razi points back to his prior explanations of noble provision.
RAZI-FULL:v26p42#2/r10.anchor: أي ذي كرم ، وقد ذكرنا ما في الكريم

STUDYQURAN:36:10/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r3.claim: These verses remind the Prophet that he cannot guide those God has not guided and should leave them to God, as 35:8 states.
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r3.anchor: These verses remind the Prophet that he cannot guide those whom God has not guided and should simply leave them to God

STUDYQURAN:36:10/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r4.speaker: IK, Q, R, Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r4.claim: The Reminder refers to the Quran itself, also discussed as Reminder at 36:69.
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r4.anchor: The Reminder is a reference to the Quran itself (IK, Q, R,Ṭ); for the Quran as Reminder, see 36:69c.

STUDYQURAN:36:10/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r5.speaker: Q, Ṭs
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r5.claim: “Fears the Compassionate unseen” may mean worshipping God while God remains unseen.
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r5.anchor: can be interpreted as a reference to worshipping God while God remains unseen or to worshipping God in seclusion (Q, Ṭs).

STUDYQURAN:36:10/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r6.speaker: Q, Ṭs
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r6.claim: Alternatively, the phrase may mean worshipping God in seclusion.
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r6.anchor: can be interpreted as a reference to worshipping God while God remains unseen or to worshipping God in seclusion (Q, Ṭs).

STUDYQURAN:36:10/r7.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r7.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r7.claim: The generous reward means Paradise or the Garden.
STUDYQURAN:36:10/r7.anchor: A generous reward here means Paradise or the Garden.

TAB-FULL:v19p408/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r1.claim: The warning does not benefit polytheists whose hearts God has sealed; the passage also contrasts them with hypocrites who neglect religion in private.
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r1.anchor: الذي قد طبع الله على قلبه

TAB-FULL:v19p408/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r2.claim: The person who benefits from warning follows the Reminder and fears the All-Merciful when unseen by observers.
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r2.anchor: هذا الذي اتبع الذكر وخشي الرحمن بالغيب

TAB-FULL:v19p408/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r3.claim: The promised forgiveness covers the believer’s sins, and the noble reward is Paradise in the afterlife.
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r3.anchor: وثواب منه له في الآخرة كريم، وذلك أن يعطيه على عمله ذلك الجنة

TAB-FULL:v19p408/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r4.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r4.claim: Qatāda explains following the Reminder as following the Quran.
TAB-FULL:v19p408/r4.anchor: عن قتادة {إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر} [يس: 11] " واتباع الذكر: اتباع القرآن

TABATABAI:36:9-11/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r10.speaker: author
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r10.claim: The restriction is an individualizing one: warning here means the effective warning that has an effect.
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r10.anchor: القصر للإفراد، والمراد بالإنذار الإنذار النافع الذي له أثر

TABATABAI:36:9-11/r11.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r11.speaker: author
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r11.claim: The Reminder is the Quran; following it means affirming it and inclining toward it when its verses are recited, while the past tense signals certainty of occurrence.
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r11.anchor: وبالذكر القرآن الكريم، وباتباعه تصديقه والميل إليه إذا تليت آياته، والتعبير بالماضي للإشارة إلى تحقق الوقوع

TABATABAI:36:9-11/r12.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r12.speaker: author
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r12.claim: Fearing the Merciful unseen means fearing God behind the veil before death or resurrection unveils reality; the alternative of fearing him while absent from people is remote.
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r12.anchor: والمراد بخشية الرحمن بالغيب خشيته تعالى من وراء الحجاب وقبل انكشاف الحقيقة بالموت أو البعث، وقيل أي حال غيبته من الناس بخلاف المنافق وهو بعيد.

TABATABAI:36:9-11/r13.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r13.speaker: author
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r13.claim: Calling God the Merciful suggests fear mixed with hope, which keeps a servant in worship without either complacency or despair.
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r13.anchor: للإشعار بأن خشيتهم خوف مشوب برجاء وهو الذي يقر العبد في مقام العبودية فلا يأمن ولا يقنط.

TABATABAI:36:9-11/r14.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r14.speaker: author
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r14.claim: The indefinite forgiveness and noble reward magnify them: forgiveness is immense and the immeasurable reward is Paradise; the context supports the interpretation.
TABATABAI:36:9-11/r14.anchor: وتنكير { مغفرة } و { أجر كريم } للتفخيم أي فبشره بمغفرة عظيمة من الله وأجر كريم لا يقادر قدره وهو الجنة

ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r1.claim: Following the Reminder means listening to the Qurʾan and following it.

ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r2.claim: Fearing the Merciful in the unseen means fearing God when no one sees the person.
ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r2.anchor: أي خاف الله من حيث لا يراه أحد

ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r3.claim: The promised forgiveness is pardon for sins, and the noble reward is Paradise.
ZAJJAJ:v4p281/r3.anchor: المغفرة هى العفو عن ذنوبه، وأجر كريم بالجنة

THALABI:v8p122/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p122/r4.speaker: author
THALABI:v8p122/r4.claim: The Prophet's warning benefits the one who follows the Qur'an, acts on it, and fears the Merciful unseen; that person receives good news of forgiveness and noble reward.
THALABI:v8p122/r4.anchor: إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر يعني إنما ينفع إنذارك- لأنه كان ينذر الكل- من اتبع الذكر: القرآن فعمل به

WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p459/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p459/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p459/r1.claim: Those whom God has led far astray do not benefit from warning; only followers of the reminder benefit, so warning others is as though they were not warned.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p459/r1.anchor: أي: من أضله الله هذا الإضلال لم ينفعه الإنذار

WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p459#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p459#2/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p459#2/r1.claim: Warning benefits the person who listens to and follows the Quran, fears God unseen by others, and receives forgiveness for sins and the good reward of Paradise.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v18p459#2/r1.anchor: {إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر} أي: من استمع القرآن واتبعه. {وخشي الرحمن بالغيب} خاف الله -عز وجل- من حيث لا يراه أحد

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:36:11-14/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:36:11-14/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:36:11-14/r1.claim: The warning benefits those who follow the Qur'an and act on it, fearing God despite not seeing Him.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:36:11-14/r1.anchor: إنما تنذر من اتبع الذكر } إنما ينفع إنذارك من اتبع القرآن فعمل به { وخشي الرحمن بالغيب } خاف الله تعالى ولم يره.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r4.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r4.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r4.claim: The warning benefits those who accept it and take heed.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r4.anchor: إنما تنذر} [يس: 11] إنما يقبل نذارتك فينتذر كقوله فيتعظ.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r5.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r5.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r5.claim: The remembrance they follow is the Quran, as in 35:18.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r5.anchor: {من اتبع الذكر} [يس: 11] ، يعني: القرآن، كقوله: {إنما تنذر الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب} [فاطر: 18] .

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r6.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r6.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r6.claim: Fearing the Merciful unseen means privately, with a heart sincere in faith.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r6.anchor: وخشي الرحمن بالغيب} [يس: 11] في السر، قلبه مخلص بالإيمان.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r7.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r7.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r7.claim: The promised forgiveness is forgiveness for the person's sin.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r8.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r8.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r8.claim: The noble reward is a noble recompense, namely Paradise.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p802/r8.anchor: وأجر كريم} [يس: 11] ، أي: وثواب كريم، الجنة.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p796/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p796/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p796/r1.claim: Warning is not restricted to unbelievers and hypocrites: believers are warned as a reminder to fulfill their duties, and the Qur’an also addresses the Prophet’s kin and those fearing resurrection.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p796/r1.anchor: الإنذار في القرآن الكريم لا يكون خاصاً للكفار والمنافقين وقد يأتي الإنذار للمؤمنين والكافرين

BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r1.speaker: بعضهم
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r1.claim: Some define a mosque's neighbor as someone living within forty homes in every direction; another view is whoever hears the call to prayer.
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r1.anchor: قال بعضهم : جار المسجد أربعون دارا من كل جانب.

BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r2.claim: If two mosques are nearby, choose the older because it has greater sanctity; if equal, choose the nearer. A scholar may choose the one with fewer attendees to increase its congregation; others may choose freely.
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r2.anchor: رجل لو كان في جواره مسجدان يصلي في أقدمهما لأن له زيادة حرمة وإن كانا سواء أيهما أقرب

BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r3.claim: For congregational acts such as obligatory prayers and tarawih, praying in a mosque is better; a home congregation earns less reward than a mosque congregation.
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r3.anchor: كل ما فيه الجماعة كالفرائض والتراويح فالمسجد فيه أفضل

BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r4.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r4.claim: A prophetic report says congregational prayer yields twenty-five times the reward of prayer at home or in the market; another version says twenty-seven, matching seventeen obligatory and ten regular prayers.
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r4.anchor: صلاة الرجل في جماعة تضعف على صلاته في بيته

BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r5.speaker: أكثر العلماء
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r5.claim: Most scholars hold that congregational prayer is obligatory.
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r5.anchor: وأكثر العلماء على أن الجماعة واجبة

BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r6.speaker: بعضهم
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r6.claim: Some scholars instead call congregational prayer a confirmed sunnah.
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r6.anchor: قال بعضهم : سنة مؤكدة وفي الحديث :

BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r7.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r7.claim: The Prophet said he considered ordering someone else to lead prayer and burning the homes of those who stayed away; the author argues he would not intend a sinful act, so this supports the permissibility of burning a home for abandoning an obligation or confirmed sunnah.
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r7.anchor: لقد هممت أن آمر رجلا يصلي بالناس وأنظر إلى أقوام يتخلفون عن الجماعة

BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r8.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r8.claim: A report promises complete light on Judgment Day to those who walk to mosques in darkness; the author says only severe darkness can excuse absence, alongside other manifest excuses.
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r8.anchor: بشروا المشائين في الظلم إلى المساجد بالنور التام يوم القيامة

BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r9.claim: Excuses for missing congregational prayer include illness warranting tayammum, disabling injury or paralysis, inability to walk, blindness, rain, mud, severe cold or darkness, and fear of rulers or other oppressors.
BURSEVI:v7p293#3/r9.anchor: والأعذار التي تبيح التخلف عن الجماعة هي المرض الذي يبيح التيمم ومثله كونه مقطوع اليد والرجل من خلاف أو مفلوجا

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p9/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p9/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p9/r1.claim: Though the prior passage denies faith despite warning, it means warning has not achieved its aim, faith; “you warn only” says that aim is reached by followers of the Reminder—Qur’an or exhortation—who fear their Lord.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p9/r1.anchor: وإنما كانت تصح هذه التقفية لو كان الإنذار منفيا . قلت : هو كما قلت ، ولكن لما كان ذلك نفيا للإيمان

TABATABAI:36:12/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:36:12/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:36:12/r1.claim: Effective warning reaches the person who follows the Qur’an, fears the Merciful with hope mingled into fear, and so may be given glad tidings of immense forgiveness and immeasurable reward.
TABATABAI:36:12/r1.anchor: من اتبع القرآن إذا تليت عليه آياته وما إليه وخشي الرحمن خشية مشوبة بالرجاء فبشره بمغفرة عظيمة وأجر كريم

ITQAN:v3p179/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p179/r1.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p179/r1.claim: Repetition is an eloquent device, more forceful than emphasis, and serves several ends, beginning with confirmation; the Qur'an says repeated warnings may lead to piety and remembrance.
ITQAN:v3p179/r1.anchor: وهو أبلغ من التأكيد وهو من محاسن الفصاحة خلافا لبعض من غلط وله فوائد منها التقرير

ITQAN:v3p179/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p179/r2.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p179/r2.claim: Repeating an address can increase attention, dispel suspicion, and help listeners accept the speech, as in the repeated يا قوم address.
ITQAN:v3p179/r2.anchor: ومنها زيادة التنبيه على ما ينفي التهمة ليكمل تلقي الكلام بالقبول ومنه ﴿ وقال الذي آمن يا قوم اتبعون أهدكم سبيل الرشاد يا قوم

ITQAN:v3p179/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p179/r3.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p179/r3.claim: After a long passage, repetition refreshes an earlier point so it is not forgotten; examples include repeated warnings and Joseph's repeated report of his dream.
ITQAN:v3p179/r3.anchor: ومنها إذا طال الكلام وخشي تناسى الأول أعيد ثانيا تطرية له وتجديدا لعهده

ITQAN:v3p179/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p179/r4.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p179/r4.claim: Repetition can magnify and overawe, as in the repeated names of the Hour and the question about the people of the right.
ITQAN:v3p179/r4.anchor: ومنها التعظيم والتهويل نحو ﴿ الحاقة ما الحاقة ﴾ ﴿ القارعة ما القارعة ﴾ ﴿ وأصحاب اليمين ما أصحاب اليمين ﴾

ITQAN:v3p179/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p179/r5.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p179/r5.claim: Repetition overlaps with emphasis but is distinct: emphasis may occur without repeated wording, while repetition can be a technical figure even when its effect is emphasis only in meaning.
ITQAN:v3p179/r5.anchor: فإنه قد يكون التأكيد تكرارا كما تقدم في أمثلته وقد لا يكون تكرارا كما تقدم أيضا وقد يكون التكرير غير تأكيد صناعة

ITQAN:v3p179/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p179/r6.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p179/r6.claim: When repeated wording is separated from its first occurrence, it is repetition rather than formal verbal emphasis, which cannot be separated from what it emphasizes.
ITQAN:v3p179/r6.anchor: ومنه ما وقع فيه الفصل بين المكررين فإن التأكيد لا يفصل بينه وبين مؤكده

TABRISI:36:14/r12.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:36:14/r12.speaker: author
TABRISI:36:14/r12.claim: After saying that the unbelievers do not believe, God says warning benefits only those who follow the Quran, since everyone has already received the warning.
TABRISI:36:14/r12.anchor: لما أخبر سبحانه عن أولئك الكفار أنهم لا يؤمنون وأنهم سواء عليهم الإنذار وترك الإنذار

TABRISI:36:14/r13.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:36:14/r13.speaker: author
TABRISI:36:14/r13.claim: The phrase can mean fearing God unseen from people, unlike a hypocrite, or fearing the unseen matters of the afterlife.
TABRISI:36:14/r13.anchor: أي في حال غيبته عن الناس بخلاف المنافق. وقيل: معناه وخشي الرحمن

TABRISI:36:14/r14.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:36:14/r14.speaker: author
TABRISI:36:14/r14.claim: The Prophet is to give such a person news of God's forgiveness and a reward free of impurities.

JISHUMI:v8p5873/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5873/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5873/r4.claim: Denial and following the reminder are human acts rather than acts created by God, refuting the Mujbira.
JISHUMI:v8p5873/r4.anchor: وتدل على أن التكذيب فعلهم، ليس بخلق الله، وكذلك اتباع الذكر، فيبطل قول المجبرة
